layer1.name: Tutorspree
layer1.one_liner: A marketplace connecting students with vetted local in-person tutors.
layer1.description: Parents searched by subject and location, Tutorspree vetted the tutors and took a cut of each booking. Two-sided marketplace, acquisition driven almost entirely by organic search at t0.
layer1.outcome_note: Shut down after a Google algorithm change removed the organic search traffic the business ran on. The postmortem is titled "When SEO fails". A pure Market Access death: the problem and the product were fine, the channel disappeared.
